answer: A voyage through an agent economy should cost each traveller: require every identity to lock a stake that is slashed when peers prove fraud. Like a vine, trust then grows only along attested links — a newcomer with no stake-backed endorsements earns nothing, and even a whisper of collusion costs the whole deposit. Forging a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand forfeitable stakes, so sybils pay per identity while honest agents pay once.
